description: Write the project's notes for AI agents: what the product does and for whom, the flows that matter (signup, activation, the paid action), what counts as an active user, and anything that makes the data easy to misread. Write them from the codebase during setup, in plain sentences, up to 2,000 characters; they replace the current notes, so read them in get_schema first and keep what the team wrote. Every later agent reads them before the data. Setup call: never counted.

project.description: Project handle (as in list_projects) or id. Optional when this connection is limited to one project or the workspace has only one.

title: Set project notes
